jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of structured finance in a global risk transfer environment? Join our dynamic Credit & Surety team in London and leverage your expertise to create innovative financial solutions that make a real impact.
 About the Role
 As a Senior Structurer, you will drive complex structured finance and portfolio transactions across diverse sectors including corporate finance, project and infrastructure finance, and trade finance. You'll navigate global markets while building and maintaining valuable relationships with our established client and broker network to source new business opportunities.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead transaction execution  by conducting thorough due diligence, including review of legal documentation, financial modelling, financial statements assessment and sector research

• Develop and present  credit memoranda addressed to senior management

• Collaborate cross-functionally  with legal, compliance and risk management teams to ensure transactions meet organizational standards and guidelines

• Monitor and manage  transactions post-closing

• Source new opportunities  through established client and broker relationships
 About the Team
 The Credit & Surety team aims at taking credit risk positions by providing risk transfer solutions to leading international banks. You will be working with a very engaged and collaborative team of experienced finance professionals. As part of the build out of the team, we are looking for a Senior Structurer reporting to the Global Head Portfolio Solutions.
 About You
 We're looking for a strategic thinker with exceptional analytical abilities who thrives in a collaborative environment. Your expertise in structured finance combined with your ability to navigate complex transactions will enable you to make an immediate impact in our growing team.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Engineering or similar field

• At least 7 years' experience with a bank or other financial institution in structured finance or corporate finance

• Excellent understanding of assessing credit obligors across a wide range of industries and structures

• Strong presentation skills with an ability to articulate clearly and concisely the aspects of complex transactions

• Ability to evaluate and take a position on transactions and defend views

• Experience in SRT transactions and other risk transfer mechanisms

• An inclusive team player approach with "hands on" attitude

• Solution-oriented mentality with enjoyment of a high-performance collaborative culture
 Are you curious to learn more about what we do, how we do it, and what your role could be? Contact us to find out.  #LI-Hybrid
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 For Switzerland, the annual base salary range for this position is between CHF 132 000 and CHF 198 000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
 #corso

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a plasmare il futuro della finanza strutturata in un ambiente globale di trasferimento dei rischi? Unisciti al nostro team dinamico di Credit & Surety a Londra e sfrutta le tue competenze per creare soluzioni finanziarie innovative che abbiano un impatto reale.
Informazioni sul ruolo
Come Senior Structurer, guiderai complesse operazioni di finanza strutturata e portafoglio in diversi settori, tra cui finanza aziendale, project e finanza infrastrutturale e finanza commerciale. Potrai navigare nei mercati globali, costruendo e mantenendo relazioni preziose con la nostra consolidata rete di clienti e broker per generare nuove opportunità di business.
Principali responsabilità

• Condurre l'esecuzione delle transazioni conducendo una stretta diligenza, compresa la revisione della documentazione legale, la modellazione finanziaria, la valutazione dei bilanci e la ricerca del settore

• Sviluppare e presentare il memoranda di credito indirizzato alla gestione senior

• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con i team legali, di conformità e di gestione dei rischi per garantire che le transazioni soddisfino gli standard organizzativi e le linee guida

• Monitorare e gestire le transazioni post-closing

• Sorgente nuove opportunità attraverso consolidate relazioni cliente e broker
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team Credit & Surety si propone di assumere posizioni di rischio di credito fornendo soluzioni di trasferimento dei rischi alle principali banche internazionali. Si lavorerà con un team molto impegnato e collaborativo di professionisti esperti di finanza. Nell'ambito della costruzione del team, stiamo cercando un Senior Structurer reporting per le soluzioni Global Head Portfolio.
A proposito di te
Stiamo cercando un pensatore strategico con eccezionali capacità analitiche che prosperano in un ambiente collaborativo. La tua esperienza nella finanza strutturata unita alla tua capacità di navigare in transazioni complesse ti permetterà di avere un impatto immediato nel nostro team in crescita.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laurea in finanza, economia, matematica, scienze attuariali, ingegneria o campo simile

• Almeno 7 anni di esperienza con una banca o un altro istituto finanziario in finanza strutturata o finanza aziendale

• Ottima comprensione della valutazione degli obblighi di credito in una vasta gamma di settori e strutture

• Forte capacità di presentazione con la capacità di articolare chiaramente e concisamente gli aspetti delle transazioni complesse

• Capacità di valutare e prendere posizione sulle transazioni e difendere le opinioni

• Esperienza nelle operazioni SRT e altri meccanismi di trasferimento dei rischi

• Un approccio inclusivo del giocatore di squadra con atteggiamento "hands on"

• mentalità orientata alla soluzione con il godimento di una cultura collaborativa ad alte prestazioni
Sei curioso di sapere di più su cosa facciamo, come lo facciamo, e quale potrebbe essere il tuo ruolo? Contattaci per scoprirlo. #LI-Hybrid #

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana
Per la Svizzera, l'intervallo di stipendio base annuale per questa posizione è compreso tra CHF 132 000 e CHF 198 000 (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione. L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un posto di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.
#corso #

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie bereit, die Zukunft der strukturierten Finanzierung in einem globalen Risikotransfer-Umfeld zu gestalten? Treten Sie unserem dynamischen Credit & Surety-Team in London bei und nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um innovative Finanzlösungen zu entwickeln, die einen echten Einfluss haben.
Über die Rolle
Als Senior Structurer treiben Sie komplexe strukturierte Finanz- und Portfoliotransaktionen in verschiedenen Sektoren voran, darunter Unternehmensfinanzierung, Projekt- und Infrastrukturfinanzierung sowie Handelsfinanzierung. Sie navigieren durch globale Märkte, während Sie wertvolle Beziehungen zu unserem etablierten Kunden- und Brokernetzwerk aufbauen und pflegen, um neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Transaktionsausführung durch gründliche Due Diligence durch, einschließlich Überprüfung der rechtlichen Dokumentation, Finanzmodellierung, Abschlussbewertung und Sektorforschung

• Entwicklung und Vorlage von Kreditvermerken an die Geschäftsleitung

• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit Rechts-, Compliance- und Risikomanagementteams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Transaktionen den organisatorischen Standards und Richtlinien entsprechen

• Überwachen und Verwalten von Transaktionen nach Abschluss

• Gewinnen Sie neue Möglichkeiten durch etablierte Kunden- und Brokerbeziehungen
Über das Team
Das Credit & Surety-Team zielt darauf ab, Kreditrisikopositionen einzugehen, indem es führenden internationalen Banken Risikotransferlösungen anbietet. Sie werden mit einem sehr engagierten und kooperativen Team von erfahrenen Finanzfachleuten zusammenarbeiten. Als Teil des Aufbaus des Teams suchen wir einen Senior Structurer, der an die Global Head Portfolio Solutions berichtet.
Über dich
Wir suchen einen strategischen Denker mit außergewöhnlichen analytischen Fähigkeiten, der in einer kollaborativen Umgebung gedeiht. Ihre Expertise in strukturierten Finanzen kombiniert mit Ihrer Fähigkeit, komplexe Transaktionen zu navigieren, wird es Ihnen ermöglichen, einen sofortigen Einfluss in unserem wachsenden Team zu erzielen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Mathematik, Versicherungsmathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder ähnlichen Bereichen

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit einer Bank oder einem anderen Finanzinstitut in strukturierten Finanzen oder Unternehmensfinanzierung

• Ausgezeichnetes Verständnis der Bewertung von Kreditschuldnern in einer Vielzahl von Branchen und Strukturen

• Starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, die Aspekte komplexer Transaktionen klar und prägnant zu artikulieren

• Fähigkeit, Transaktionen zu bewerten und Stellung zu nehmen und Ansichten zu verteidigen

• Erfahrung mit SRT-Transaktionen und anderen Risikoübertragungsmechanismen

• Ein inklusiver Teamplayer-Ansatz mit "Hands On" -Haltung

• Lösungsorientierte Mentalität mit Freude an einer leistungsstarken Kooperationskultur
Sind Sie neugierig darauf, mehr darüber zu erfahren, was wir tun, wie wir es tun und welche Rolle Sie spielen könnten? Kontaktieren Sie uns, um es herauszufinden. #LI-Hybrid

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind
Für die Schweiz liegt die jährliche Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen CHF 132 000 und CHF 198 000 (für eine Vollzeitstelle). Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,

• das eigene Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.
Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.
#corso

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir du financement structuré dans un environnement global de transfert des risques? Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique de Credit & Surety à Londres et exploitez votre expertise pour créer des solutions financières innovantes qui ont un impact réel.
À propos du rôle
En tant que structureur principal, vous dirigerez des opérations complexes de financement structuré et de portefeuille dans divers secteurs, notamment le financement des entreprises, le financement des projets et des infrastructures et le financement du commerce. Vous naviguerez sur les marchés mondiaux tout en établissant et en maintenant des relations précieuses avec notre réseau de clients et de courtiers établis pour créer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires.
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger l'exécution des opérations en faisant preuve de diligence raisonnable, notamment en examinant la documentation juridique, la modélisation financière, l'évaluation des états financiers et la recherche sectorielle

• Élaborer et présenter des mémorandums de crédit à l'intention de la haute direction

• Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec les équipes de gestion des risques, du respect des lois et des règlements afin de s'assurer que les transactions respectent les normes et directives organisationnelles

• Surveiller et gérer les transactions après la fermeture

• Source de nouvelles possibilités grâce à des relations établies avec les clients et les courtiers
À propos de l'équipe
L'équipe Credit & Surety vise à prendre des positions de risque de crédit en fournissant des solutions de transfert de risque aux principales banques internationales. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe très engagée et collaborative de professionnels des finances expérimentés. Dans le cadre du développement de l'équipe, nous recherchons un cadre supérieur qui relève du Global Head Portfolio Solutions.
À propos de toi
Nous recherchons un penseur stratégique doté de capacités analytiques exceptionnelles qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif. Votre expertise en finance structurée combinée à votre capacité de naviguer sur des transactions complexes vous permettra d'avoir un impact immédiat dans notre équipe en pleine croissance.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, économie, mathématiques, sciences actuarielles, génie ou domaine similaire

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience avec une banque ou une autre institution financière en finance structurée ou en finance d'entreprise

• Excellente compréhension de l'évaluation des débiteurs de crédit dans un large éventail d'industries et de structures

• Compétences solides en matière de présentation et capacité d'articuler clairement et de façon concise les aspects des transactions complexes

• Capacité d'évaluer et de prendre position sur les transactions et de défendre les opinions

• Expérience dans les transactions SRT et autres mécanismes de transfert de risques

• Une approche inclusive des joueurs d'équipe avec une attitude "mains sur"

• La mentalité axée sur la solution avec la jouissance d'une culture collaborative de haute performance
Êtes-vous curieux d'en savoir plus sur ce que nous faisons, comment nous le faisons et quel pourrait être votre rôle? Contactez-nous pour savoir. #LI-Hybrid

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine
Pour la Suisse, l'échelle annuelle des salaires de base pour ce poste se situe entre 132 000 et 198 000 francs suisses (pour un rôle à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.
En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement. L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales de nos 50 sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embrasse un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

 Ihre Hauptaufgaben

• Erarbeiten, Weiterentwickeln und gemeinsames Produzieren des kalten und warmen Angebotes im Bereich Get&Give sowie des Salatbuffets in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceleiter und Küchenchef

• Aktives Unterstützen des Teams während den Produktions- und Servicezeiten in der Küche und an der Front

Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. Ihre Hauptaufgaben

• Erarbeiten, Weiterentwickeln und gemeinsames Produzieren des kalten und warmen Angebotes im Bereich Get&Give sowie des Salatbuffets in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceleiter und Küchenchef

• Führen des Teams mit klaren Zielen sowie Verantwortung für die Mitarbeiterbeurteilung

• Die Arbeitszeiten sind von Montag – Freitag, vorwiegend von 06:00 – 15:00 Uhr und Abendeinsätze bei Anlässen

• Eintritt per 1. November 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Swiss Re Gastronomy – Ihr Arbeitsumfeld
Corporate Real Estate & Services Zurich (CRES Zurich) ist eine Abteilung von Swiss Re Management Ltd, welche unter anderem verantwortlich für die Führung der internen Gastronomie und Hotellerie ist. Neben der Gemeinschafts-Gastronomie in Zürich, führt CRES Zurich das Guest Restaurant K2 und das Casual Restaurant sowie das Konferenzzentrum mit Hotelbetrieb Centre for Global Dialogue in Rüschlikon.
Unter einem Dach vereint das Klubhaus am Campus-Mythenquai insgesamt sieben effizient organisierte, gastronomische Teilkonzepte. Auf dem Dach befindet sich der Genussgarten, auf dem Swiss Re Gastronomy neben hauseigenem Honig auch Gemüse, Kräuter, Blüten und Salate zum sofortigen Eigengebrauch und für haltbare Kioskartikel und Giveaways anbaut.
Sie bringen mit

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Koch/Köchin EFZ

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in unterschiedlichen Gastronomiebetrieben

• Erste Führungserfahrung sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu fördern und weiterzuentwickeln

• Hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung sowie ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- Kostenbewusstsein

• Neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen verfügen Sie auch über gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse

• Sehr gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse sowie sicherer Umgang den gängigen MS Office Programmen
Was wir bieten

• Hohes gastronomisches Niveau in der Mitarbeiterverpflegung

• Abwechslungsreiches und gepflegtes Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Konzepten und vielfältigen Anlassformaten

• Moderne, wertschätzende Führungskultur, Einbezug von Mitarbeitenden in Entscheidungen

• Gelebte Nachhaltigkeit, Regionalität, Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt

• Interne Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Zur Verfügung gestellte Uniform, inkl. Reinigung

• Stark vergünstigtes ZVV Abo

• Gratis-Fitnessmöglichkeiten

• Überdurchschnittliche Pensionskasse, Vorsorge- und Versicherungsleistungen
Für die Schweiz liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 76'000 CHF und 101'000 CHF (bei einer Vollzeitstelle). Das konkret angebotene Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• die Anforderungen, den Umfang, die Komplexität und die Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle,

• das Profil der Bewerberin bzw. des Bewerbers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.
Zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive, leistungsabhängige variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen anerkennt. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl globaler und standortspezifischer Zusatzleistungen.
Die Anspruchsberechtigung kann je nach den Richtlinien von Swiss Re und dem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Swiss Re – Ihr Arbeitgeber
Dies ist Ihre Chance, bei der Swiss Re Group einzusteigen - einem der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen innovativen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers. Bei Swiss Re geht es darum, die grossen Risiken, die die Welt betreffen, zu verstehen und zu analysieren - von Naturkatastrophen bis zum Klimawandel, von der Überalterung der Bevölkerung bis zur Cyberkriminalität. Wir kombinieren Erfahrung mit Fachwissen und innovativem Denken, um neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Dies ist nur möglich mit rund 10'000 aussergewöhnlichen Mitarbeitenden der Swiss Re Gruppe weltweit.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

• ein  internationales  und  multikulturelles  Umfeld

• sostenere lo sviluppo digitale, la trasformazione e l'innovazione delle aree di business

• catturare e analizzare le domande nel business digitale di tutti i giorni e ottimizzare processi e prodotti da loro

Sei un:e giocatore di squadra:in, può ascoltare bene e chiedere specificamente. Poi l'apprendistato come sviluppatore: nel business digitale EFZ con noi è esattamente quello giusto per voi!
Cosa offriamo

• Un ambiente internazionale e multiculturale

Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We provide innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations worldwide, helping our clients manage risk and build resilience in an increasingly complex world.
 As part of our ambition to become a data-driven commercial insurer, we are strengthening our Data Architecture capability to support strategic business transformation, modern data platforms, and enterprise-wide data governance.
 About the Role
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect to act as the senior Design Authority within the Corporate Solutions Data Architecture team.
 Reporting to the Head of Data Architecture & Data Engineering, this role provides architectural leadership across a globally distributed team of Data Architects and Data Modellers. The Lead Data Architect is responsible for ensuring the consistent application of architecture standards, reviewing and assuring solution designs, and providing guidance on complex cross-domain data architecture challenges.
 The role combines strong business engagement, architecture governance, conceptual, logical and physical modelling expertise, and deep knowledge of modern data platforms. Working closely with business, technology, and governance stakeholders, the Lead Data Architect will help ensure that strategic initiatives deliver scalable, governed, and reusable data solutions.
 The role is strategically located in Zurich to enable close collaboration with key stakeholders across Group Data Services (GDS), CorSo Data Governance, CorSo Operational Model Excellence (OMEX), Data & Technology Finance (DT Finance), Business Architecture, and strategic Digital & Technology product teams.
 The role is very much focused on constantly improving the data landscape aimed at democratizing our data assets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead and mentor a team of data architects across the globe to contribute to long-term objectives to democratise data for business and technical consumption and reduce technical debt.

• Act as delegated Design Authority for Data Architecture across Corporate Solutions.

• Review and assure solution architectures, data models, integration designs, and solution contracts against established architecture principles and standards.

• Provide architectural guidance and decision support for complex business and technology initiatives.

• Manage and promote Data Architecture artefacts (Canonical Model, Physical Models, Data Catalogue, Domain Data flows, Master Data and Meta Data management). Driving consistency and reuse across data architecture deliverables.

• Coordinate architecture activities across business domains including Customer, Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Reserving, and Operations to embed data quality, lineage, metadata management, cataloguing, and observability into architectural designs.

• Ensure consistency of conceptual, logical, canonical, and physical data models across domains.

• Partner with CorSo Data Governance, OMEX, and Group Data Services to ensure compliance with data governance standards and governance frameworks.
 About the Team
 The Data Architecture team plays a critical role in enabling Corporate Solutions' ambition to become a data-driven commercial insurer.
 The team is responsible for ensuring consistent, scalable, and governed data architecture across the insurance value chain, supporting underwriting, claims, finance, operations, customer management, and strategic transformation initiatives.
 Working closely with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Business Architecture, and Product teams, the function provides the architectural foundation that enables trusted, accessible, and high-quality data across Corporate Solutions.
 About You
 You are a highly experienced Data Architect with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-scale data architecture solutions in complex organisations. You are equally comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, reviewing solution designs, and coaching other architects.
 You bring a pragmatic approach to architecture, balancing governance and standards with delivery outcomes and business value.
 Demonstrable interest in leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI technologies to improve Data Architecture practices, including data modelling, documentation, architecture governance, metadata management, and design productivity.
 Required Experience

• Minimum 10+ years in Data Architecture, Information Architecture, or Enterprise Data Management, with at least 2 years in team lead positions.

• Expert in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling; experience with CASE tools (e.g., SAP Sybase PowerDesigner).

• Hands-on experience designing and building modern data architecture, including data warehouse, Lakehouse and end-to-end enterprise data platforms.

• Strong knowledge of SQL or PySpark for complex data analysis

• Experience in SDLC and Agile/SCRUM environments.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• Experience in information & data governance and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Experience with modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise-scale solutions)

• Industry experience in Insurance/Re-Insurance is highly desirable.

• Proven track record of delivering results and impact in complex, global environments.
 Personal Attributes

• Strategic and analytical thinker.

• Strong communicator and collaborator.

• Influential without relying on formal authority.

• Passionate about data and architecture excellence.

• Committed to continuous learning and improvement.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global environment.
 For Switzerland the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus
 Why Join Us?
 This is an opportunity to shape the future of data architecture at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, enabling our ambition to become a truly data-driven commercial insurer. You will work in a dynamic, global environment that values curiosity, adaptability, and collaboration.
 Equal Opportunity & Accommodations
 Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are based solely on an individual's qualifications for the position.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodation for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

The role combines strong business engagement, architecture governance, conceptual, logical and physical modelling expertise, and deep knowledge of modern data platforms. Working closely with business, technology, and governance stakeholders, the Lead Data Architect will help ensure that strategic initiatives deliver scalable, governed, and reusable data solutions.
The role is strategically located in Zurich to enable close collaboration with key stakeholders across Group Data Services (GDS), CorSo Data Governance, CorSo Operational Model Excellence (OMEX), Data & Technology Finance (DT Finance), Business Architecture, and strategic Digital & Technology product teams.
The role is very much focused on constantly improving the data landscape aimed at democratizing our data assets.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead and mentor a team of data architects across the globe to contribute to long-term objectives to democratise data for business and technical consumption and reduce technical debt.

• Act as delegated Design Authority for Data Architecture across Corporate Solutions.

• Review and assure solution architectures, data models, integration designs, and solution contracts against established architecture principles and standards.

• Provide architectural guidance and decision support for complex business and technology initiatives.

• Manage and promote Data Architecture artefacts (Canonical Model, Physical Models, Data Catalogue, Domain Data flows, Master Data and Meta Data management). Driving consistency and reuse across data architecture deliverables.

• Coordinate architecture activities across business domains including Customer, Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Reserving, and Operations to embed data quality, lineage, metadata management, cataloguing, and observability into architectural designs.

• Ensure consistency of conceptual, logical, canonical, and physical data models across domains.

• Partner with CorSo Data Governance, OMEX, and Group Data Services to ensure compliance with data governance standards and governance frameworks.
About the Team
The Data Architecture team plays a critical role in enabling Corporate Solutions' ambition to become a data-driven commercial insurer.
The team is responsible for ensuring consistent, scalable, and governed data architecture across the insurance value chain, supporting underwriting, claims, finance, operations, customer management, and strategic transformation initiatives.
Working closely with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Business Architecture, and Product teams, the function provides the architectural foundation that enables trusted, accessible, and high-quality data across Corporate Solutions.
About You
You are a highly experienced Data Architect with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-scale data architecture solutions in complex organisations. You are equally comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, reviewing solution designs, and coaching other architects.
You bring a pragmatic approach to architecture, balancing governance and standards with delivery outcomes and business value.
Demonstrable interest in leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI technologies to improve Data Architecture practices, including data modelling, documentation, architecture governance, metadata management, and design productivity.
Required Experience

• Minimum 10+ years in Data Architecture, Information Architecture, or Enterprise Data Management, with at least 2 years in team lead positions.

• Expert in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling; experience with CASE tools (e.g., SAP Sybase PowerDesigner).

• Hands-on experience designing and building modern data architecture, including data warehouse, Lakehouse and end-to-end enterprise data platforms.

• Strong knowledge of SQL or PySpark for complex data analysis

• Experience in SDLC and Agile/SCRUM environments.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• Experience in information & data governance and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Experience with modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise-scale solutions)

• Industry experience in Insurance/Re-Insurance is highly desirable.

• Proven track record of delivering results and impact in complex, global environments.
Personal Attributes

• Strategic and analytical thinker.

• Strong communicator and collaborator.

• Influential without relying on formal authority.

• Passionate about data and architecture excellence.

• Committed to continuous learning and improvement.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global environment.
For Switzerland the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus

This is an opportunity to shape the future of data architecture at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, enabling our ambition to become a truly data-driven commercial insurer. You will work in a dynamic, global environment that values curiosity, adaptability, and collaboration.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.title: Financial Reporting Analyst - Graduate
jobs.description:
Start your journey towards a rewarding career!

We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our 18-month Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027.

You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient.

By the end of the programme, you’ll have built the skills, foundations and network to pursue a wide range of career opportunities within Swiss Re.
 This early recruitment cycle is dedicated specifically to Group Strategy and Group Reporting & FP&A Graduate positions .
 Additional Graduate opportunities across P&C, L&H, Risk Management, Finance & Asset Management functions in Zurich, London, Paris, Milan, and Bratislava will be advertised from  November onwards.

About the Role

As a Finance Reporting Analyst in the Life & Health (L&H) Finance team, you will contribute to the financial reporting and analysis of our L&H business, working alongside seasoned specialists across the globe.

This is a wonderful opportunity to build deep expertise in financial performance reporting, contribute to high-impact deliverables, and grow your career in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and coordinate quarterly financial reporting processes, partnering with Group Finance and regional finance teams across multiple geographies

• Analyse and interpret L&H financial performance data, providing clear and insightful explanations of variances against internal and external targets

• Consolidate financial inputs from a diverse range of stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of reporting outputs

• Contribute to external L&H disclosures and internal management reporting, supporting the delivery of high-quality analysis used for strategic steering purposes

• Identify opportunities for process improvement within reporting workflows, driving efficiency and quality enhancements

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support ad hoc financial analyses and special projects as required by senior management

About the Team

We are a vibrant, multinational team based in Zürich, working closely with specialists around the world. Our team holds ownership of the consolidated L&H results, with a sharp focus on both external disclosures and internal management reporting. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, actionable analysis to senior management that directly supports strategic decision-making.

We are a team that genuinely values curiosity, continuous learning, and high-quality work. You will find a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are welcomed, questions are encouraged, and your development is taken seriously. Whether you are navigating your first financial reporting cycle or presenting findings to senior leaders, you will have the support of experienced colleagues who are invested in your growth.

About You

You are curious, analytical, and genuinely excited about the world of finance and reinsurance. You enjoy working with financial data and are motivated by the idea of turning complex information into clear, compelling narratives. You bring a proactive mindset, strong organisational skills, and a natural ability to communicate with people across different teams and geographies. You are comfortable working under time pressure without compromising on quality, and you approach challenges with resilience and a desire to keep learning.

You hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience. You are eligible to work in Switzerland and are available to begin the programme on 1 September 2027.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's level), demonstrating a strong academic grounding in financial and quantitative disciplines

• Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

• Knowledge of or strong academic exposure to IFRS accounting standards, with an understanding of how these apply within financial reporting contexts

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data, and deliver high-quality outputs under time pressure

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to present findings clearly to diverse audiences

These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with reinsurance, insurance, or broader financial services industry

• Interest in or experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly as they relate to improving financial reporting and analysis

• Knowledge of data visualisation or reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

Please note: The application process will remain open until at least October 18th. We greatly appreciate every application and carefully review each one. As a result, the selection process may take some time, but please rest assured that your application is being given thorough consideration. We aim to provide an update on your application by November 16th at the latest.

Candidates selected for the final stage will be invited to our Assessment Centre on Friday, November 27th, preceded by an informal networking dinner with Swiss Re representatives on the evening before. Please ensure you are available for both events.

To learn more about the programme and the recruitment process, visit our website: Graduate Programme | Swiss Re

We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. descriptionByLocale.it:
Inizia il tuo viaggio verso una carriera gratificante!

Siamo alla ricerca di laureati curiosi e motivati con competenze di persone forti che vogliono crescere, imparare e fare la differenza. Se si possiede una laurea, Master, o PhD e hanno fino a tre anni di esperienza professionale, si applicano per il nostro programma di laurea di 18 mesi a partire dal 1 settembre 2027.

Potrai acquisire esperienza pratica nel mondo della riassicurazione veloce, ruotare in diverse squadre locali, e ricevere formazione su misura per costruire la tua esperienza. Questa è la vostra opportunità di modellare la vostra carriera, aiutare a proteggere le società dai pericoli più minacciosi del mondo, e contribuire a rendere il mondo più resiliente.

Entro la fine del programma, avrai costruito le competenze, le basi e la rete per perseguire una vasta gamma di opportunità di carriera all'interno di Swiss Re.
Questo primo ciclo di reclutamento è dedicato specificamente alle posizioni di Group Strategy and Group Reporting & FP&A Graduate .
Ulteriori opportunità di laurea in P&C, L&H, Risk Management, Finance & Asset Management a Zurigo, Londra, Parigi, Milano e Bratislava saranno pubblicizzate da novembre in poi.

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di Finance Reporting Analyst nel team Life & Health (L&H) Finance, contribuirai al reporting finanziario e all'analisi del nostro business L&H, lavorando insieme a specialisti esperti in tutto il mondo.

Questa è una splendida opportunità per costruire una profonda esperienza nella rendicontazione delle prestazioni finanziarie, contribuire ai risultati di alto impatto, e crescere la tua carriera in un ambiente di supporto e intellettualmente stimolante.

Principali responsabilità

• Coordinare e coordinare i processi di reporting finanziario trimestrale, collaborando con i team di finanza di gruppo e finanza regionale in più geografie

• Analizzare e interpretare i dati delle prestazioni finanziarie L&H, fornendo spiegazioni chiare e approfondite delle variazioni contro obiettivi interni ed esterni

• Consolidare gli input finanziari da una vasta gamma di stakeholder, garantire precisione, coerenza e tempestività dei risultati di report

• Contribuire a divulgazioni L&H esterne e report di gestione interna, sostenendo la consegna di analisi di alta qualità utilizzate per scopi di sterzo strategico

• Identificare le opportunità di miglioramento del processo all'interno dei flussi di lavoro di segnalazione, efficienza di guida e miglioramenti di qualità

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per sostenere analisi finanziarie ad hoc e progetti speciali come richiesto da senior management

Informazioni sulla squadra

Siamo un team vivace e multinazionale con sede a Zurigo, lavorando a stretto contatto con specialisti in tutto il mondo. Il nostro team detiene la proprietà dei risultati consolidati L&H, con una forte attenzione sia alla divulgazione esterna che al reporting di gestione interna. Siamo orgogliosi di fornire analisi di alta qualità e attuabili alla gestione senior che supporta direttamente il processo decisionale strategico.

Siamo un team che valorizza sinceramente la curiosità, l'apprendimento continuo e il lavoro di alta qualità. Troverete un ambiente collaborativo e inclusivo in cui sono accolte diverse prospettive, le domande sono incoraggiate, e il vostro sviluppo è preso sul serio. Che tu stia navigando il tuo primo ciclo di rendicontazione finanziaria o presentando i risultati ai leader senior, avrai il supporto di colleghi esperti che vengono investiti nella tua crescita.

A proposito di te

Siete curiosi, analitici e sinceramente entusiasti del mondo della finanza e della riassicurazione. Ti piace lavorare con i dati finanziari e sono motivati dall'idea di trasformare le informazioni complesse in narrazioni chiare e convincenti. Porti una mentalità proattiva, forti capacità organizzative, e una capacità naturale di comunicare con le persone di diverse squadre e geografie. Sei comodo lavorare sotto la pressione del tempo senza compromettere la qualità, e ti avvicini alle sfide con la resilienza e il desiderio di continuare a imparare.

Hai una laurea, Master, o PhD e hai fino a tre anni di esperienza professionale. È possibile lavorare in Svizzera e sono disponibili per iniziare il programma il 1o settembre 2027.

Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia, Business o un campo correlato (livello di laurea o Master), dimostrando una forte base accademica nelle discipline finanziarie e quantitative

• Proficienza in Excel e PowerPoint

• Conoscenza o forte esposizione accademica agli standard contabili IFRS, con una comprensione di come questi si applicano all'interno dei contesti di rendicontazione finanziaria

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di interpretare i dati finanziari, e fornire risultati di alta qualità sotto pressione del tempo

• Eccellente inglese scritto e parlato, con la capacità di presentare i risultati chiaramente a diversi pubblico

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Familiarità con la riassicurazione, l'assicurazione, o più ampio settore dei servizi finanziari

• Interesse o esperienza con strumenti e tecnologie AI, in particolare per quanto riguarda il miglioramento della reportistica finanziaria e dell'analisi

• Conoscenza degli strumenti di visualizzazione o di segnalazione dei dati (ad esempio, Power BI, Tableau)

La gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione sarà condivisa con voi durante il processo di intervista.

Nota: il processo di applicazione rimarrà aperto fino al 18 ottobre. Apprezziamo molto ogni applicazione e accuratamente rivediamo ciascuno. Di conseguenza, il processo di selezione può richiedere un po 'di tempo, ma si prega di assicurarsi che la vostra applicazione è dato una considerazione approfondita. Ci proponiamo di fornire un aggiornamento sulla vostra applicazione entro il 16 novembre al più tardi.

I candidati selezionati per la fase finale saranno invitati al nostro centro di valutazione venerdì 27 novembre, preceduto da una cena informale di networking con i rappresentanti della Swiss Re la sera prima. Assicuratevi di essere disponibili per entrambi gli eventi.

Per saperne di più sul programma e sul processo di reclutamento, visita il nostro sito web: Graduate Programme | Swiss Re

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Start your journey towards a rewarding career!

We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our 18-month Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027.

You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient.

By the end of the programme, you’ll have built the skills, foundations and network to pursue a wide range of career opportunities within Swiss Re.
This early recruitment cycle is dedicated specifically to Group Strategy and Group Reporting & FP&A Graduate positions .
Additional Graduate opportunities across P&C, L&H, Risk Management, Finance & Asset Management functions in Zurich, London, Paris, Milan, and Bratislava will be advertised from  November onwards.

About the Role

As a Finance Reporting Analyst in the Life & Health (L&H) Finance team, you will contribute to the financial reporting and analysis of our L&H business, working alongside seasoned specialists across the globe.

This is a wonderful opportunity to build deep expertise in financial performance reporting, contribute to high-impact deliverables, and grow your career in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and coordinate quarterly financial reporting processes, partnering with Group Finance and regional finance teams across multiple geographies

• Analyse and interpret L&H financial performance data, providing clear and insightful explanations of variances against internal and external targets

• Consolidate financial inputs from a diverse range of stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of reporting outputs

• Contribute to external L&H disclosures and internal management reporting, supporting the delivery of high-quality analysis used for strategic steering purposes

• Identify opportunities for process improvement within reporting workflows, driving efficiency and quality enhancements

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support ad hoc financial analyses and special projects as required by senior management

About the Team

We are a vibrant, multinational team based in Zürich, working closely with specialists around the world. Our team holds ownership of the consolidated L&H results, with a sharp focus on both external disclosures and internal management reporting. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, actionable analysis to senior management that directly supports strategic decision-making.

We are a team that genuinely values curiosity, continuous learning, and high-quality work. You will find a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are welcomed, questions are encouraged, and your development is taken seriously. Whether you are navigating your first financial reporting cycle or presenting findings to senior leaders, you will have the support of experienced colleagues who are invested in your growth.

About You

You are curious, analytical, and genuinely excited about the world of finance and reinsurance. You enjoy working with financial data and are motivated by the idea of turning complex information into clear, compelling narratives. You bring a proactive mindset, strong organisational skills, and a natural ability to communicate with people across different teams and geographies. You are comfortable working under time pressure without compromising on quality, and you approach challenges with resilience and a desire to keep learning.

You hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience. You are eligible to work in Switzerland and are available to begin the programme on 1 September 2027.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's level), demonstrating a strong academic grounding in financial and quantitative disciplines

• Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

• Knowledge of or strong academic exposure to IFRS accounting standards, with an understanding of how these apply within financial reporting contexts

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data, and deliver high-quality outputs under time pressure

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to present findings clearly to diverse audiences

These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with reinsurance, insurance, or broader financial services industry

• Interest in or experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly as they relate to improving financial reporting and analysis

• Knowledge of data visualisation or reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

Please note: The application process will remain open until at least October 18th. We greatly appreciate every application and carefully review each one. As a result, the selection process may take some time, but please rest assured that your application is being given thorough consideration. We aim to provide an update on your application by November 16th at the latest.

Candidates selected for the final stage will be invited to our Assessment Centre on Friday, November 27th, preceded by an informal networking dinner with Swiss Re representatives on the evening before. Please ensure you are available for both events.

To learn more about the programme and the recruitment process, visit our website: Graduate Programme | Swiss Re

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Beginnen Sie Ihre Reise in Richtung einer lohnenden Karriere!

Wir suchen neugierige, motivierte Absolventen mit starken Fähigkeiten, die wachsen, lernen und etwas bewirken wollen. Wenn Sie einen Bachelor, Master oder PhD haben und bis zu drei Jahre Berufserfahrung haben, bewerben Sie sich für unser 18-monatiges Graduiertenprogramm ab dem 1. September 2027.

Sie erhalten praktische Erfahrungen in der schnelllebigen Welt der Rückversicherung, wechseln in verschiedene lokale Teams und erhalten eine maßgeschneiderte Schulung, um Ihr Fachwissen aufzubauen. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ihre Karriere zu gestalten, Gesellschaften vor den bedrohlichsten Gefahren der Welt zu schützen und dazu beizutragen, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen.

Am Ende des Programms haben Sie die Fähigkeiten, Grundlagen und das Netzwerk aufgebaut, um eine breite Palette von Karrieremöglichkeiten bei Swiss Re zu verfolgen.
Dieser frühe Rekrutierungszyklus ist speziell auf Gruppenstrategie und Gruppenberichterstattung & FP & A Graduate Positionen gewidmet.
Weitere Graduate-Möglichkeiten in den Bereichen P&C, L&H, Risk Management, Finance & Asset Management in Zürich, London, Paris, Mailand und Bratislava werden ab November ausgeschrieben.

Über die Rolle

Als Finance Reporting Analyst im Life & Health (L&H) Finance Team tragen Sie zur Finanzberichterstattung und Analyse unseres L&H-Geschäfts bei und arbeiten mit erfahrenen Spezialisten auf der ganzen Welt zusammen.

Dies ist eine wunderbare Gelegenheit, um fundiertes Know-how in der finanziellen Performance-Berichterstattung aufzubauen, zu hochwirksamen Ergebnissen beizutragen und Ihre Karriere in einem unterstützenden und intellektuell anregenden Umfeld auszubauen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Eigene und koordinierte vierteljährliche Finanzberichterstattungsprozesse, Partnerschaft mit Group Finance und regionalen Finanzteams in mehreren Regionen

• Analyse und Interpretation von L&H-Daten zur finanziellen Performance und Bereitstellung klarer und aufschlussreicher Erklärungen zu Abweichungen gegenüber internen und externen Zielen

• Konsolidierung der Finanzbeiträge einer Vielzahl von Interessengruppen, um Genauigkeit, Konsistenz und Aktualität der Berichtsergebnisse zu gewährleisten

• Beitrag zu externen L&H-Offenlegungen und internem Management-Reporting, Unterstützung der Bereitstellung hochwertiger Analysen für strategische Steuerungszwecke

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Prozessverbesserung innerhalb von Reporting-Workflows, zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Qualitätsverbesserungen

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Ad-hoc-Finanzanalysen und spezielle Projekte nach Bedarf der Geschäftsleitung zu unterstützen

Über das Team

Wir sind ein dynamisches, multinationales Team mit Sitz in Zürich und arbeiten eng mit Spezialisten auf der ganzen Welt zusammen. Unser Team ist Eigentümer der konsolidierten L&H-Ergebnisse, mit einem starken Fokus auf externen Offenlegungen und internen Management-Reporting. Wir sind stolz darauf, der Geschäftsleitung qualitativ hochwertige, umsetzbare Analysen zu liefern, die strategische Entscheidungen direkt unterstützen.

Wir sind ein Team, das Neugier, kontinuierliches Lernen und qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit wirklich schätzt. Sie werden ein kollaboratives und integratives Umfeld vorfinden, in dem verschiedene Perspektiven willkommen sind, Fragen gefördert werden und Ihre Entwicklung ernst genommen wird. Egal, ob Sie Ihren ersten Finanzberichterstattungszyklus navigieren oder die Ergebnisse leitenden Führungskräften präsentieren, Sie werden von erfahrenen Kollegen unterstützt, die in Ihr Wachstum investiert sind.

Über dich

Sie sind neugierig, analytisch und wirklich begeistert von der Welt der Finanzen und der Rückversicherung. Sie arbeiten gerne mit Finanzdaten und sind motiviert, komplexe Informationen in klare, überzeugende Narrative zu verwandeln. Sie bringen eine proaktive Denkweise, starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und eine natürliche Fähigkeit mit Menschen in verschiedenen Teams und Regionen zu kommunizieren. Sie arbeiten gerne unter Zeitdruck, ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität einzugehen, und Sie gehen Herausforderungen mit Widerstandsfähigkeit und dem Wunsch an, weiter zu lernen.

Sie haben einen Bachelor, Master oder PhD und haben bis zu drei Jahre Berufserfahrung. Sie sind berechtigt, in der Schweiz zu arbeiten und können das Programm am 1. September 2027 beginnen.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich (Bachelor- oder Master-Niveau), der eine starke akademische Basis in finanziellen und quantitativen Disziplinen zeigt

• Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint

• Kenntnis oder starkes akademisches Engagement in Bezug auf die IFRS-Rechnungslegungsstandards, mit einem Verständnis dafür, wie diese im Kontext der Finanzberichterstattung gelten

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Finanzdaten zu interpretieren und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse unter Zeitdruck zu liefern

• Hervorragendes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch, mit der Fähigkeit, die Ergebnisse klar für verschiedene Zielgruppen zu präsentieren

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Vertrautheit mit Rückversicherung, Versicherung oder breiterer Finanzdienstleistungsbranche

• Interesse an oder Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und -Technologien, insbesondere in Bezug auf die Verbesserung der Finanzberichterstattung und -analyse

• Kenntnisse der Datenvisualisierung oder Reporting-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau)

Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position wird während des Interviewprozesses mit Ihnen geteilt.

Bitte beachten Sie: Das Bewerbungsverfahren bleibt bis mindestens 18. Oktober geöffnet. Wir schätzen jede Anwendung sehr und überprüfen jede sorgfältig. Daher kann der Auswahlprozess einige Zeit in Anspruch nehmen, aber seien Sie versichert, dass Ihre Bewerbung gründlich geprüft wird. Wir sind bestrebt, bis spätestens 16. November ein Update zu Ihrer Bewerbung bereitzustellen.

Die für die Abschlussphase ausgewählten Kandidaten werden am Freitag, den 27. November, in unser Assessment Center eingeladen, dem am Vorabend ein informelles Networking-Dinner mit Vertretern von Swiss Re vorausgeht. Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie für beide Veranstaltungen verfügbar sind.

Um mehr über das Programm und den Rekrutierungsprozess zu erfahren, besuchen Sie unsere Website: Graduate Programme | Swiss Re

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.
